lastChange.note: CalendarPage template and calendar styles: one calendar (day, week, month) and one drag-and-drop base for every app; entries move by drag, long press and arrow keys with a live preview, colour by tone as an edge and tint. Before that: Page templates like Stille: BoardPage (InfraLink projects by phase), TablePage and ActivityPage; segment control in the Toggle card; tabs focus as an inner outline. Before that, Stille sidebar: 240px without a fill of its own, a border line, 32px muted rows, neutral hover and selection, 28px group titles, counters and hover actions, 56px collapsed. Before that, simplified like Stille: README in Stille's structure (ground rules, content, colour, type, space, motion, touch, icons, use), 30 short component cards (Markup, Rules, Source) instead of 57; FormField and SearchField fold into Input, Sheet into Dialog, Table into DataTable, StaffNavigation becomes Sidebar; app-specific cards, index.d.ts and the unused Archivo, Martian Mono and Roboto fonts removed; token notes cut to one sentence. Earlier: aligned with Stille: Geist and Geist Mono everywhere, 30/36 page title, 4px spacing scale, 10px radius base (6/8/10/14), shadow-sm on cards and fields, shadow-md on floating layers, 36px controls (40px touch, 44px touch rows), Stille motion and status as dot plus word; PlanerLink, CaleLink and PhysioLink darkened for tint contrast; LokaLink text darkened to oklch(0.48 0.12 50) for active filter chips on the Loka background. One component per pattern: OtpField (40px cells, 44px touch) for every numeric code, CommandMenu with CommandMenuTrigger as the Portal and Admin search, LoadingStatus, Badge count variants with pulse, EmptyState block form, segmented ToggleGroup; Stille motion for icon hover, floating layers, toasts and Kanban FLIP.
